reverse_case: one exact actor property -> unary field
predicate_filter_cost: T_coord(predicate)+T_risk; full-scan reference O(R) for one coordinate if no physical acceleration assumed
early_termination_or_sparsity: no-match can stop before respondent work; zero-support can stop before target grouping
optional_materialization: comparator receipt + fixed E1 field OPTIONAL_CACHE_CANDIDATE
semantic_correctness: exact comparator receipt; population field only; no actor belief assignment

actor_comparator_cost: rule lookup + interval/band resolution; cost proportional rule/crosswalk entries examined absent layout assumption
predicate_filter_cost: evaluate resolved exact interval predicate over governed coordinate incidence + risk set
early_termination_or_sparsity: typed noncomparable or unmapped interval terminates early
semantic_correctness: range semantics must be authority-owned; nearest-band fallback forbidden

multi_universe_cost: NONE or per-source lookup until negative status established
early_termination_or_sparsity: cheapest lawful path; returns typed no-match/noncomparability rather than approximate cohort
cache_invalidation: comparator authority or actor fact/source changes
semantic_correctness: negative authority is output, not failure to be hidden

actor_comparator_cost: resolve rule and enumerate candidate matches sufficient to prove ambiguity
predicate_filter_cost: NONE unless separate authority instructs evaluation of alternatives
early_termination_or_sparsity: typed MULTIPLE_LAWFUL_ALTERNATIVES may terminate without Cartesian expansion; product of alternatives is not a mandatory cost unless authority explicitly requests alternative fields
semantic_correctness: do not choose fuzzy best match merely to save cost

reverse_case: valid comparator but zero respondent support
predicate_filter_cost: predicate+risk-set evaluation required to establish empty exact cohort
target_field_cost: no target contingency beyond empty/typed support result
early_termination_or_sparsity: terminates after zero-support proof; no nearest-cohort fallback
optional_materialization: zero-support fact may be cached under exact identity
semantic_correctness: zero support != impossible actor; result is no empirical conditional basis

predicate_filter_cost: same-respondent conjunction/intersection T_conj(K); reference O(K*R) without acceleration
target_field_cost: one target grouping over selected cohort
early_termination_or_sparsity: selectivity may shrink cohort but live selectivity unknown; any comparator failure may terminate or yield typed ambiguity before scan
optional_materialization: K comparator receipts + fixed conjunction E1 optional
semantic_correctness: never multiply independent conditional probabilities; exact conjunction required

reverse_case: K actor properties -> J-way joint field
target_field_cost: J target binding + sparse contingency O(sum_j E_j_selected + J*N_joint + M_J); M_J<=min(N_joint,product_j C_j)
multi_universe_cost: sum_u T_joint(u) for admitted universes; preserve components
early_termination_or_sparsity: sparse occupied-cell representation can avoid dense product C_j storage while domains preserve observed-zero meaning; lower-order projections cannot replace J-way
semantic_correctness: exact requested joint; parity/XOR supported; no direct actor state

actor_comparator_cost: resolve comparator separately where source-specific semantics differ
predicate_filter_cost: predicate evaluated independently per source universe
target_field_cost: unary or J-way field independently per universe
early_termination_or_sparsity: no respondent join/pooling by default; one source no-match does not imply another source no-match
semantic_correctness: disagreement remains information; locality does not create source priority weight

reverse_case: fixed exact E2 cache hit for reverse query
actor_comparator_cost: comparator receipt still must bind actor facts to exact cached conditioner identity unless itself cached
predicate_filter_cost: identity/provenance validation instead of deep predicate scan
target_field_cost: read exact fixed contingency instead of rebuilding J-way field
early_termination_or_sparsity: large replay saving possible only when actor-condition/target/risk-set/source/topology/measure identities exactly match
cache_invalidation: any identity dimension change invalidates hit; new target/condition is miss
semantic_correctness: cache is bounded-query accelerator, never future-frontier retention substitute

actor_comparator_cost: validate actor fact hash/effective time + rule/source/version identity
predicate_filter_cost: unchanged empirical predicate may be reused
target_field_cost: field still requires query/cache unless separately materialized
early_termination_or_sparsity: saves authority/crosswalk resolution only; empirical field cost remains
semantic_correctness: receipt must not silently survive authority supersession

predicate_filter_cost: predicate plus exact routing/applicability member-set evaluation
target_field_cost: event-grain topology binding over E rather than scalar respondent rows; set/order/repeat semantics add event processing
early_termination_or_sparsity: cost can exceed scalar target because multiple events per respondent; multiplicity is semantically unavoidable when source topology has it
semantic_correctness: first-row/dedup shortcut forbidden unless authority proves scalar singularity

reverse_case: reverse field with raw and governed weighted measure
target_field_cost: accumulate raw support and authorized weighted mass; uncertainty method lookup where governed
early_termination_or_sparsity: invalid/missing weight yields typed unavailable weighted result rather than unit-weight substitution
optional_materialization: fixed field cache may carry both raw/weighted measures under exact weight basis
cache_invalidation: weight variable/design/estimand/recalibration authority or source data changes
semantic_correctness: raw and weighted measures remain distinct; no fabricated design-based certainty
